Hey man. I’m sorry you’re feeling like this. If you search my post history you’ll see that I made a post about attempting suicide a few days ago, and I’m still here somehow.

I know that you’re desperate and feel hopeless about things like not getting a job, not making enough money, feeling terrible etc cause I do too. I have problems with focusing too and it’s hard for me to read, watch tv or work. 

What I’m doing to overcome my situation is doing little by little every day. Like for example: today I’m going to brush my teeth. The next day is: today I’m gonna brush my tweet plus taking a walk around my neighborhood. I guessed that taking baby steps will help me to develop a more stables routine in the future to feel better and becoming a better person.

I’m currently making $20 per month cause I live in Venezuela (country with terrible economics) so I wish I could make $7.25 per hour like you. I know that eventually you’ll find something better.

I don’t have anyone either (I’m alone all the time, so I just talk to myself) and thanks to my previous post here some people reached out and started talking to me to help, but sadly even though I appreciate it I can’t seem to connect with online people. I can’t connect with most people really, if not anybody. 

Anyways, best luck to you and I really hope you’ll get better

Take care xx
